sections.title: Everyday Neuroendocrinology (A)
sections.description: This ABCS course blends academically based community service with a senior seminar focused on neuroendocrinology.  Students in the course will design and teach lessons for high school students that focus on hormones and behavior.  In parallel, college students will participate in journal club-style discussions focused on basic and clinical science discoveries pertinent to these topics. This combination of content learning and community engagement supports Penn's mission to relentlessly create and apply knowledge for the good of society. This is an Academically Based Community Service (ABCS) course.
